notes: The clause-initial *It* is `added` and the copula goes to the comparative preposition heading the predicate, per rules 20, 25 and 49; rule 10 keeps the antecedent in v.1 from licensing it here.

The anarthrous `יֹרֵד` shows none of rule 41's four marks of predication — no subject or resumptive pronoun, no coordinated finite clause, no parallel main-clause rendering, and the participle follows rather than precedes its noun — so the supplied *That* stays with the attributive and is not `added`.
The ASV marginal note *Or, collar* on `פִּי מִדּוֹתָיו` was read and set aside under rule 38; the printed *skirt* is what is aligned.
